fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: devnet-7: Prysm on parallel fork; all other clients at head
devnet-8 target: early next week (~Tuesday); named public testnet, optional client releases requested
devnet-8 spec live Monday/Tuesday at launch; Gloas fork ~1 week after genesis; deposits via Dora

eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: EIP-8359 (Beacon Block Reporting Field): 32-byte non-consensus field for CL/EL client + validator setup reporting; PFI'd
EIP-8198 (Quick Slots): reduce slot time 12s→10s anchor target; removes hardcoded 12s assumption; Lido and Arbitrum have upgrade paths; PFI'd
VOPS profiles for FOCIL eligibility: informational EIP defining which transaction types get FOCIL inclusion guarantees; PFI'd
EIP-8142 (Blob Columns Propagation): puts execution payloads into blobs, leverages PeerDAS + cell-level deltas; open concerns from potuz re ePBS/PTC deadline conflicts; PFI'd
EIP-8C71 (LOTAS / Distributed Blob Space Construction): distributes PeerDAS reconstruction load via row topics + bitmaps; no full DAS change; PFI'd

EIP-8363 (Tapered Issuance Burn): burns fraction of validator rewards to cap staking ratio at 50%; intense community opposition; Greg (Lido) requested voluntary withdrawal from Hegota PFI; Jerome declined; Ansgar noted community consensus prerequisite for any CFI; PFI'd
EIP-7716 (Anti-Correlation Attestation Penalties): updated curve now ~2–22x higher than original draft; focuses on source/target only, drops head vote; PFI'd

EIP-12097 / EIP-12099 (BLS Withdrawal Credential Retirement + Balance Sunset): force-exit 0x00 validators, slowly drain balances to zero before PQ transition; potuz skeptical of complexity; Barnabas suggested simpler: stop new 0x00 deposits in H*, force-exit in I*; PFI'd

glamsterdam_updates.highlight: EIP-8070 sparse blob pool Engine API V4 changes: no CL objections on call; cutoff for counter-proposal is Monday ACDT

action_items.action: CL teams: signal implementation status of EIP-8070 Engine API changes in interop channel before Monday ACDT
Discuss EIP-8363 further on ETH R&D issuance channel and ETH Magicians thread; no CFI decision on call

decisions.decision: EIP-8070 sparse blob pool Engine API changes included in devnet-8 unless objection raised by Monday ACDT
EIP-8198 (Quick Slots): gas limit and blob count per block scale down with slot time; throughput per second held constant; other parameter changes (issuance, blob count) require separate EIPs
EIP-8363 PFI is valid per process (permissionless); no CFI or SFI decision made; community consensus explicitly stated as prerequisite for future acceptance

PFI for Hegota: EIP-8359 (Beacon Block Reporting), EIP-8198 (Quick Slots), VOPS FOCIL Profiles, EIP-8142 (Blob Columns Propagation), EIP-8C71 (LOTAS), EIP-8363 (Tapered Issuance Burn), EIP-7716 (Anti-Correlation Penalties), EIP-12097/12099 (BLS Withdrawal Retirement + Balance Sunset)
EIP-8333 (Align Checkpoint with Epoch Boundary Block) and Engine API sync status EIP deferred to next ACDC
Polar bear selected as Hegota mascot
